text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 200, "unit": "students", "kind": "count", "span": "a class of 200 students"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 10, "unit": "students", "kind": "count", "span": "the last one is 10 less than each of the other groups"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 3, "unit": "groups", "kind": "count", "span": "split into 3 groups"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "top the smallest group up so all three groups would be equal"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "the size of each of the two equal groups"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "the smallest group is 10 fewer than an equal group"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the number of students in the smallest group"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "'2 of them are equal in number' labels how many groups match; that equality is already carried by dividing the evened-out total by 3"}, {"value": 1, "reason": "'the last one' points at the smallest group; it is a label, not a count"}]}
